2023-3755-4068-4770.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Mountain.
2023-3755-4068-4770.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying its mana cost.
Aragorn triggers, creating a 1/1 Human Soldier creature token.
When Whitemane Lion enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Whitemane Lion and the Human Soldier token by tapping them, adding {1}{W}.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

5170-5231-6132-8175.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Metamorphosis Fanatic.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic dies, Edgar triggers, causing you to gain 1 life
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Edgar trigger.
Resolve the Edgar trigger, causing you to gain 1 life
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Metamorphosis Fanatic from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

116-512-3443.easyPrerequisites: Deathbloom Ritualist and Kiora's Follower do not have summoning sickness.
116-512-3443.notablePrerequisites: You have at least two creature cards in your graveyard.
116-512-3443.description:
Activate Deathbloom Ritualist by tapping it, adding at least {W}{W}
Activate Kiora's Follower by tapping it, targeting Halo Fountain.
Holding priority, activate Halo Fountain by paying {W}{W}, tapping it, and untapping Kiora's Follower and Deathbloom Ritualist, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Kiora's Follower ability, untapping Halo Fountain.
Repeat.
116-512-3443.notes: Once you have drawn your library, you may instead forego activating Deathbloom Ritualist's ability to activate Halo Fountain's first ability to create near-infinite 1/1 Citizen creature tokens.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

6972-7156-8095.description:
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Arcbound Hybrid.
When Arcbound Hybrid dies, its modular ability and persist ability trigger.
Resolve the modular trigger, putting Arcbound Hybrid's +1/+1 counters on another artifact creature.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning Arcbound Hybrid from your graveyard to the battlefield. It will not have a -1/-1 counter on it due to its modular ability.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Repeat.

824-2728-5662-6797.easyPrerequisites:
Genestealer Patriarch does not have summoning sickness.
An opponent controls a creature.
Leech Bonder is tapped and does not have summoning sickness.
824-2728-5662-6797.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two additional creatures.
824-2728-5662-6797.description:
Declare Genestealer Patriarch as an attacker.
Genestealer Patriarch's first ability triggers, putting an infection counter on a creature an opponent controls.
Activate Leech Bonder's ability by paying its cost, moving the infection counter from the opponent's creature onto a creature you control.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing the creature with an infection counter on it.
When the creature dies, Reyhan and Genestealer Patriarch's second ability trigger.
Resolve the Reyhan trigger, putting an infection counter onto another creature you control.
Resolve the Genestealer Patriarch trigger, causing you to create a token copy of the sacrificed creature that is a Tyranid in addition to its other types.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Repeat from step 4.

2707-5751-6504-7753.description:
Activate Conjurer's Bauble by tapping and sacrificing it, putting a land from your graveyard onto the bottom of your library and causing you to draw the land.
Cast Conjurer's Bauble from your graveyard for its retrace cost by paying {0} and discarding a land.
Repeat.

821-5220-6772-6900.description:
Activate Mogg Fanatic by sacrificing it.
When Mogg Fanatic dies, Mortuary and Syr Vondam trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Mogg Fanatic from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Syr Vondam trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and putting a +1/+1 counter on Syr Vondam.
Resolve the Mogg Fanatic ability.
Cast Mogg Fanatic from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

2459-4050-4763--21.description:
Activate the Equipment by paying its equip cost, attaching it to Rograkh.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Rograkh, adding {R}.
When Rograkh dies, Koll triggers, returning Rograkh from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Rograkh by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

104-2086-5256.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Kitchen Finks.
When Kitchen Finks dies, its persist ability triggers, returning Kitchen Finks from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Kitchen Finks enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to gain 3 life.
Cleric Class triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Kitchen Finks.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat.

784-1750-2793-5261-5315.notablePrerequisites: Silas Renn cannot be blocked by an opponent.
784-1750-2793-5261-5315.description:
Activate Ravenous Intruder by sacrificing Ugin's Nexus.
When Ugin's Nexus is sacrificed, it is exiled instead of being put into your graveyard, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Move to your next turn.
Activate Isochron Scepter by paying {2} and tapping it, casting a copy of Pull from Eternity without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Pull from Eternity, putting Ugin's Nexus from exile into your graveyard.
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Silas Renn, triggering Silas Renn, targeting Ugin's Nexus.
Cast Ugin's Nexus from your graveyard by paying {5}.
Repeat.

509-1267-1781-4883.manaNeeded: {3}{U}{R} available the first turn, with {4} each extra turn
509-1267-1781-4883.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
509-1267-1781-4883.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Medomai the Ageless.
Medomai the Ageless triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Thran Forge by paying {2}, causing Medomai the Ageless to become an artifact.
Cast Idris by paying {1}{U}{R}.
When Idris enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Medomai the Ageless until Idris leaves the battlefield.
Move to your extra turn.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Idris's vanishing ability triggers, removing a time counter from it.
Activate Contagion Clasp by paying {4} and tapping it, putting a time counter on Idris.
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Idris.
Idris triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat from step 6.

457-4985-5078-5390.description:
Cast Sensei's Divining Top by paying {0}.
Forensic Gadgeteer triggers, creating a Clue token.
Activate Urza's first ability by tapping the Clue, adding {U}.
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top from the battlefield on top of your library.
Activate the Clue by paying {1} and sacrificing it, causing you to draw Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library.
Repeat.

2743-5461-5473.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block and kill creatures you control.
2743-5461-5473.description:
Activate Calamity's saddle ability by tapping Biovisionary, causing Calamity to become saddled until end of turn.
Declare Calamity as an attacker.
Calamity triggers twice, creating four token copies of Biovisionary that are tapped and attacking.
At the beginning of your end step, Calamity triggers eight times and each Biovisionary triggers once.
Resolve the first Biovisionary trigger, causing you to win the game.

2136-4071.notablePrerequisites:
Orthion does not have summoning sickness.
Opponents have a collective life total of 150 or less, or your deck size is equal to or greater than 5 times the number of Demons you control and your life total is equal to or greater than that number plus one.
2136-4071.description:
Activate Orthion's second ability by paying {6}{R}{R}{R} and tapping it, creating five token copies of Be'lakor.
Put all the Be'lakor tokens into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Each Be'lakor token's first ability triggers, the nontoken Be'lakor's second ability triggers five times, and each Be'lakor token's second ability triggers four times.
Resolve the nontoken Be'lakor triggers, dealing 30 damage to up to 5 targets.
Resolve all the Be'lakor tokens' second abilities, dealing 120 damage to up to 20 targets.
If needed, resolve all the Be'lakor tokens' first abilities, causing you to draw five cards for each Demon you control and lose that much life.

393-1656-4762.notablePrerequisites:
Necrotic Ooze does not have summoning sickness.
It is your precombat main phase.
393-1656-4762.description:
During your precombat main phase, activate Necrotic Ooze using Alaborn Veteran's ability by tapping it, giving it +2/+2 until end of turn.
Activate Necrotic Ooze using Devoted Druid's second ability by putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping it.
Repeat.
Once Necrotic Ooze has infinite toughness, you may instead use Devoted Druid's first ability to get infinite green mana.

50-52-2060-3525.notablePrerequisites:
Vedalken Certarch does not have summoning sickness.
Pemmin's Aura attached to Vedalken Certarch.
You control at least three artifacts.
An opponent controls an untapped creature.
50-52-2060-3525.description:
Activate Vedalken Certarch by tapping it, tapping a creature an opponent controls.
Solitary Sactuary triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Crystalline Crawler.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {U}.
Activate Pemmin's Aura's first ability by paying {U}, untapping Vedalken Certarch.
Repeat.
You may also repeat this loop during each turn.

2634-3105-3593.description:
Cast Pyretic Ritual by paying {1}{R}.
Holding priority, activate Rootha by paying {2} and returning it from the battlefield to your hand, copying Pyretic Ritual.
Resolve the copy of Pyretic Ritual, adding {R}{R}{R}.
Activate Sneak Attack by paying {R}, putting Rootha from your hand onto the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.n: Fable of the Mirror-Breaker // Reflection of Kiki-Jiki

1636-2785-3337.notablePrerequisites:
Reflection of Kiki-Jiki does not have summoning sickness.
You have attacked this turn.
1636-2785-3337.description:
Activate Reflection of Kiki-Jiki by paying {1} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Mardu Warshrieker with haste.
The Mardu Warshrieker token enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Intruder Alarm.
Resolve the Mardu Warshrieker trigger, adding {R}{W}{B}.
Resolve the Intruder Alarm trigger, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.

1479-3678-5233.notablePrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
1479-3678-5233.description:
Play Boros Garrison.
When Boros Garrison enters the battlefield, it, Retreat to Emeria, and Kodama of the East Tree trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Boros Garrison trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Retreat to Emeria trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Boros Garrison from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Boros Garrison enters the battlefield, it and Retreat to Emeria trigger.
Repeat from step 4.

1295-2679.notablePrerequisites: There are no white cards in library.
1295-2679.description:
Activate Sacred Guide for {1}{W}, exiling your library.
Cast Thassa's Oracle, winning the game on ETB.
